description: The Customer Profiles actions as typed sub-blocks, each with its catch-all: get_customer_profile in both of its forms, profile_request_data an object holding identifier_name and identifier_value, and one holding search_criteria, a list of two objects, and logical_operator, each with its MultipleFoundError and NoneFoundError branches; create_customer_profile with profile_request_data a map holding a listed field written unquoted (FirstName, PhoneNumber) and an Attributes.x key written quoted ("Attributes.loyaltyTier"), and profile_response_data a list holding one of each; update_customer_profile with an Attributes.x key and a listed field and one response name; and associate_contact_to_customer_profile with profile_request_data an object of its two ids, each a JSONPath, and profile_response_data the empty list the console writes. No refs: the Customer Profiles domain is the instance's integration, not a parameter. Awaits the provider release that carries these blocks (tasks/D10), so it has no validate directory yet.
